meta.title: Remote setter & closer jobs (m/f/d), commission based
meta.description: NexAI is looking for self-employed setters and closers (m/f/d) to sell AI employees: one-off commission on the close plus monthly commission for as long as the customer stays. No clawbacks, remote across DACH. Apply now.

hero.title: Sell AI employees. Earn every month for as long as the customer stays.
hero.description: NexAI is looking for self-employed setters and closers (m/f/d) who win businesses over the phone. Commission only, no base: a one-off commission on the close and a monthly commission that keeps running for as long as the customer stays. No clawbacks, no cap.
hero.reassurance: No fees, no courses, no starter kit. You sell, we provide the product, the leads and the tech.

positioning.headline: A real B2B product with monthly revenue.
positioning.body: NexAI builds digital employees: AI agents that answer the phone for small and medium-sized businesses, reply in the website chat and take over routine work. Customers pay monthly, which is exactly why, as a senior, you earn not just on the close but every single month. We are a young company and are building our sales team right now. Whoever joins now helps shape it.

product.title: Digital employees every customer understands instantly.
product.description: Four products, one principle: the AI takes over tasks the customer currently lacks the time or staff for. You show on the phone in two minutes what that sounds like.

items.title: Voice Agent
items.description: Answers the phone around the clock, handles questions and books appointments. For every business that loses calls.

items.title: Chat Agent
items.description: Replies on the website instantly, qualifies enquiries and passes them on. No prospect waits until the next working day.

items.title: Social Media Agent
items.description: Answers messages and comments and prepares posts. The customer stays visible without posting themselves.

items.title: Automation
items.description: Takes over recurring office work and connects the customer's tools with each other. Saves hours every day.

roles.title: Three roles, two levels, one model.
roles.description: Every role starts as a junior and becomes a senior after onboarding. Commission is calculated on the customer's net base: the customer's payment minus NexAI's costs for operation, technology and support. We show you the exact rates in the intro call and in the career system you receive as a PDF after applying.

labels.oneTime: One-off commission in the first month, for junior and senior
labels.monthly: Monthly commission from month 2, recurring, as a senior
labels.monthlyJunior: No monthly commission yet as a junior

items.name: Setter
items.tasks: You call decision-makers in small and medium-sized businesses, spark interest and book qualified appointments for the closer.
items.promotion: Within 4 weeks with 50, 75, 100 and 125 calls per week and at least 3 appointments that took place.
items.fit: you enjoy the phone, don't take a no personally and like structure.

items.name: Closer
items.tasks: You run the sales conversations on appointments from the setter pool, show the AI live and bring the contract home.
items.promotion: Within 4 weeks with 3, 5, 7 and 10 appointments held per week and at least 2 closed deals.
items.fit: you run sales conversations, like objections and close cleanly.

items.name: Setter + Closer
items.tasks: You book your own appointments and close them yourself. The commission is the sum of both roles, no split with anyone.
items.promotion: The criteria of both roles, each on your own appointments.
items.fit: you want to go the whole way from the first call to the signature yourself.

roles.basisNote: The net base is the customer's payment minus NexAI's costs for operation, technology and support. Your commission is calculated on that. There is no setup fee; the base is always the recurring monthly payment. Percentages and a worked example come with the intro call and the career system PDF.
rules: No customer cap: your income keeps growing with every customer.
No clawbacks: commission that has been paid out is never reclaimed. If a customer cancels, only the further monthly commission stops.
If a customer pays annually, the one-off commission is still based on the monthly amount. The monthly commission is then paid as a bundle on the anniversary.
roles.customersText: Trades businesses, medical practices, law firms, service providers. B2B, on the phone, cold calling verified company contacts. If you expect warm enquiries from coaching ads, this is the wrong place. If you can do real B2B sales, it's the right one.

path.title: Four weeks, clear criteria, no favouritism.
path.description: Every role starts as a junior. The promotion criteria are public and objective so you know where you stand from day 1.

columns.extra: Plus at least 3 appointments that took place within the 4 weeks.
Plus at least 2 closed deals within the 4 weeks.

path.bothNote: Setter + Closer: both sets of criteria, each on your own appointments.
senior: Higher one-off commission than at junior level.
Recurring monthly commission for as long as the customer stays.
path.note: As a junior, one or two sales meetings per week are part of onboarding. We listen in on selected calls for coaching; calls are only recorded with an announcement and the customer's consent. The goal is to get better, not to control.

support.title: You sell. We provide the rest.
support.description: No starter kit, no fees. Everything you need to sell comes from NexAI.

items.title: Verified company contacts
items.description: Setters start with decision-maker contacts from public sources, with verified phone number and industry. No research on your side.

items.title: Appointments from the setter pool
items.description: Closers get the appointments our setters book, with background on the business. We don't promise a minimum number; you can see the pipeline at any time.

items.title: Live demo on the phone
items.description: A number every customer can call right away. The AI runs the conversation; you don't have to explain anything.

items.title: Customer deck and offer logic
items.description: Ready-made presentation, ROI calculator and a clear path from the first conversation to the offer.

items.title: Partner portal
items.description: Your customers, orders and commissions at a glance at app.nex-a-i.com, including invoicing to NexAI.

items.title: Shared CRM
items.description: Contacts, appointments and status in one place. Your contacts stay assigned to you, no double calls by colleagues.

items.title: Sales meetings and coaching
items.description: One or two meetings per week during onboarding, optional afterwards. Conversations get better together.

items.title: Direct line
items.description: You talk to the founders, not to a ticket system. Short paths, fast answers.

demo.title: Call our AI before you apply.
demo.description: This is the product you sell. The AI answers the phone, handles questions and books appointments. You're talking to the AI, not to us.
demo.hint: Costs you only the call at German landline rates. The AI tells you at the start that it is an AI. The demo speaks German.

honest.resultText: Then read the questions below, run your numbers and apply. We get back to you within 2 working days.

process.title: From application to your first call.

steps.title: Application in 2 minutes
steps.description: Fill in the form, pick your role, say briefly what you bring. You immediately receive a confirmation with the career system as a PDF.

steps.title: Intro call, 30 minutes
steps.description: Right after applying you book a call with Maximilian Trenk. We clarify expectations, product and commission in both directions.

steps.title: Contract, onboarding, start
steps.description: Sales partner contract, access to portal and CRM, deck and demo. Then you start as a junior, with meetings during onboarding.

faq.title: Questions setters and closers ask us.

items.q: Do I need a registered business?
items.a: Yes. You work as a self-employed sales partner (commercial agent under § 84 of the German Commercial Code) and invoice us monthly. A small business registration is enough. We show you what the invoice looks like during onboarding.
No. No fees, no training packages, no mandatory purchases. You need a phone, a laptop and an internet connection.

After the customer's payment has arrived at NexAI, monthly against your invoice. The one-off commission comes with the customer's first payment, the monthly commission from the second month with every further payment for as long as the customer stays.

We never reclaim commission that has been paid out. If a customer cancels, only the further monthly commission stops from the following month. If a customer never pays an invoice, however, no commission arises for that invoice either.

items.q: Can I do this on the side?
items.a: Yes. You organise your own time. The promotion criteria are weekly numbers; how and when you reach them is up to you.

items.q: Do I have to work exclusively for NexAI?
items.a: No. You may sell other products and work for other clients. We only expect you not to refer NexAI customers to a competing offer.

items.q: Where do the leads come from, and how good are they?
items.a: From public company sources, checked by us: industry, decision-maker, phone number. They are cold B2B contacts, not enquiries. What becomes of them is decided by your call.

items.q: How many appointments do I get as a closer?
items.a: As many as our setters book. We don't promise a fixed number because we can't guarantee it. You can book appointments yourself at any time; for those customers the setter + closer commission applies.

items.q: What does the product cost the customer?
items.a: Prices are individual because every agent is built differently. You get the offer logic and the exact commission rates in the intro call and in the career system PDF that arrives by email after you apply.

items.q: What happens if I don't reach the junior criteria?
items.a: Then we talk about why and decide together whether and how to continue. You receive the one-off commission for your closed deals in any case.

items.q: What does the contract look like, and how do I cancel?
items.a: A sales partner contract under German law: self-employed, no base pay, no minimum term, cancellable by either side with four weeks' notice to the end of the month. Commission claims that have already arisen remain. You receive the contract before signing and read it at your own pace.

items.q: I'm in Austria or Switzerland. Does that work?
items.a: Yes, as long as you sell remotely in German and are allowed to be self-employed in your country. The contract is governed by German law.

items.q: I run an agency and want to refer customers rather than sell myself.
items.a: Then our partner programme for companies is the better fit. You'll find it at nex-a-i.com/partner.

jsonld.title: Sales partner setter / closer (m/f/d), self-employed, commission only, remote
jsonld.description: NexAI is looking for self-employed setters and closers (m/f/d) in the DACH region who win small and medium-sized businesses over the phone for digital employees (AI voice agent, chat agent, social media agent, automation). Work as a self-employed commercial agent under § 84 of the German Commercial Code, 100 % remote, free time management, no exclusivity. Compensation is purely performance-based, no base pay: a one-off commission on the net base in the customer's first month (depending on role and level), from the second month a recurring monthly commission for senior positions, no customer cap, no clawbacks; the exact rates are shared in the intro call. Requirements: registered business (or equivalent self-employment in AT/CH), business-fluent German, phone, laptop and internet. NexAI provides verified company contacts, appointments from the setter pool, a live demo number, customer deck, partner portal, CRM and coaching.
jsonld.responsibilities: Setter: call decision-makers in small and medium-sized businesses, spark interest, book qualified appointments. Closer: run sales conversations, show the AI live, close contracts. Setter + closer: both in one person.
jsonld.qualifications: Registered business or equivalent self-employment, business-fluent German, phone sales experience an advantage, own hardware and internet connection.
jsonld.incentive: Commission only, no base pay: one-off commission on the net base in the first month; monthly commission from month 2 for senior positions, recurring, no cap, no clawbacks. Exact rates shared in the intro call.
